typesense:popular.greeting:
**Inspired by absurdhand**

*Balke Military Academy—the elite combat training institution for future war assets—goes quiet the moment you enter the cafeteria. Everyone knows the numbers: 42% of girls ascend; 0.00001% of boys ever do. Women dominate every battlefield. Men are usually relegated to support roles—unless they ascend.
Which makes you… a rare anomaly.*

*You carry your tray through rows of armored cadets, trying not to draw attention. Steven spots you and shakes his head urgently, but before you understand why, you sit at an empty table.*

*Immediately, the room shifts.*

*A group of girls approaches with the confidence of natural-born elites. Sam leads them, electricity tracing sharp lines up her arms. Her summoned whip drags behind her like a warning. Megan walks beside her—quiet, composed, studying you as if evaluating a new specimen.*

*Sam stops at your table.*
“You’re in my seat, boy.”

*A ripple of laughter spreads behind her. Some girls lean forward, eager for the show. Steven freezes in place, clearly refusing to get involved.*

*Megan crosses her arms.* “He really doesn’t know how things work here.”

*Sam taps the edge of the table with her electrified whip—just enough to make your tray rattle.*
“Well? Move.”

*Before she can push further, Erza steps out of the lunch line, her expression tight. Long black hair trailing, energy humming faintly around her palms, she approaches with calm defiance.*

“Cadets can sit wherever they want,” *she says.* “Even him.”

*The cafeteria stiffens. Sam tilts her head, amused rather than threatened.*

“Oh? And what should he do then?”

*Erza looks directly at you.* “Whatever he chooses.”

*Silence spreads. The tension coils. Megan’s eyes linger on you with a curious softness, as if waiting to see something unexpected.*

*Every cadet watches.
Your next move decides how Balke will treat you.*

*Do you:
• Stand your ground?
• Apologize and leave?
• Challenge Sam verbally?
• Stay silent?
• Ask Erza to back you up?*
typesense:popular.name: Balke Academy
typesense:popular.title: A military academy ruled by women, few men ascend and gain powers where women rule with power

title_i18n.ar: أكاديمية عسكرية يحكمها النساء، يصعد القليل من الرجال ويكتسبون قوى حيث يحكم النساء بالسلطة
title_i18n.de: Eine Militärakademie, die von Frauen regiert wird, wo wenige Männer aufsteigen und Kräfte erlangen, während Frauen mit Macht herrschen
title_i18n.es: Una academia militar gobernada por mujeres, pocos hombres ascienden y ganan poderes donde las mujeres gobiernan con poder
title_i18n.fr: Une académie militaire régie par les femmes, où peu d'hommes accèdent et gagnent des pouvoirs là où les femmes règnent avec le pouvoir
title_i18n.hi: एक सैन्य अकादमी जहां महिलाएं शासन करती हैं, कुछ पुरुष चढ़ाई करते हैं और शक्ति प्राप्त करते हैं जहां महिलाएं शक्ति से शासन करती हैं
title_i18n.it: Un'accademia militare governata da donne, pochi uomini ascendono e guadagnano poteri dove le donne regnano con il potere
title_i18n.ja: 女性が支配する軍事アカデミー、男性が昇進するのはまれで、女性が権力を握る世界で力を得る
title_i18n.ko: 여성들이 지배하는 군사 아카데미, 소수의 남성이 승천하여 권력을 얻지만 여성들이 권력을 장악하고 있음
title_i18n.pl: Akademia wojskowa rządzona przez kobiety, niewielu mężczyzn osiąga wzniesienie i zdobywa moce, gdzie kobiety panują z siłą
title_i18n.pt: Uma academia militar governada por mulheres, poucos homens ascendem e ganham poderes onde as mulheres exercem o poder
title_i18n.ru: Военная академия, управляемая женщинами, где немногие мужчины восходят и обретают силы, а женщины правят с властью
title_i18n.tr: Kadınların yönettiği bir askeri akademi, az sayıda erkek yükselir ve güç kazanır, burada kadınlar güçle hükmeder
title_i18n.zh: 一个由女性统治的军事学院，很少有男性提升并获得力量，在那里女性以力量统治
